bio: Anna Angela Villella was baptized at San Mango di Aquino in Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy, on 10 December 1722, the daughter of Antonio (Antonino) Villella and Maria Maletta. On 7 May 1746 she married Antonio Sacco of Pittarella. She was still living in 1798. She was John's 8th-great-grandmother.
